items.title: Why your underwires poke your armpits
items.caption:
Why do your underwires keep poking into your armpits? 🇬🇧✨

If you wear a UK DD–GG, wide wires are an anatomical mismatch, not "just how bras feel". Polish ateliers use narrow wires and deep projection to channel volume up and forward.

✨ Gorsenia K496 Paradise Soft Balcony (UK 32F–44E).
💬 Tell us: do your wires poke at the center gore or under your arms? 👇

A 36DD is often a 32G in disguise. ✨

If department stores only carried 36DD, your band is likely doing too little and your straps too much. European sizing runs in true centimeters, so 32G finally gives you a band that stays put.

✨ Gorsenia Paradise K496 Soft Balcony in Midnight Black.
